title: Neumorphism.io
lede: The CSS shadow generator that spread the style’s recipe, itself built on one pale gray surface.
summary: Adam Giebl’s neumorphism generator: a demo shape, sliders, and the paired box-shadow code.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear. The demo shape and the control panel share the gray page color and rise from it with a white glow and a gray shadow. The tool is also the most-used source of the style’s CSS.

context: The source is on GitHub as [adamgiebl/neumorphism](https://github.com/adamgiebl/neumorphism), created on 29 December 2019, BSD-3-Clause, about 6,200 stars on 2026-09-28.
observed: A pale gray page (#e0e0e0). A large rounded square in the same gray sits at the left with a white glow at upper left and a gray shadow at lower right.
A raised panel in the same gray holds sliders for Size, Radius, Distance, Intensity, and Blur, and four shape buttons (flat, concave, convex, pressed).
A dark navy code box shows `box-shadow: 20px 20px 60px #bebebe, -20px -20px 60px #ffffff`.
Headings and labels are a navy sans-serif. A small dark GitHub button at top right shows 6,162 stars.
interpretation: The generator states the style’s rule as code: two shadows with equal and opposite offsets and a blur three times the offset. [CSS-Tricks](ref:css-tricks-neumorphism-and-css-2020) names it as the generator of the trend.
Only the demo and the panel carry shadows; the text below is plain, so the page-level shadow share is low.
Measured: shadows on 11 % of boxes (median offset 28.3 px, median blur 60 px, none hard), borders on 25 %, median radius 6 px.
borrow: Set the blur to two or three times the offset and derive both shadow colors from the surface color, as the generator does.

images.alt: Neumorphism.io generator home page: a pale gray rounded square with soft white and gray shadows beside a raised gray panel of navy sliders, shape buttons, and a dark box of CSS box-shadow code.
images.caption: First viewport of [neumorphism.io](https://neumorphism.io/).
